fact: Car 6 collided with Car 12 in Turn 9.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 6 (Isack Hadjar), the driver of Car 12 (Kimi Antonelli), team representatives and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video and in-car video evidence. Car 6 ran into the back of Car 12 at Turn 9 in heavy rain and crashed into the barriers. Both drivers said that the visibility was so poor in the rain that they simply could not see anything in front of them. The driver of Car 12 stated that he slowed down earlier than normal due to the heavy rain. This caught Car 6 by surprise. A collision occurred but that was unavoidable as both viewed themselves as passengers in the rain. In these circumstances, they considered that no driver could be blamed for the collision. We agreed and therefore took no further action against the driver of Car 6.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
team: Visa Cash App Racing Bulls F1 Team
title: Decision Car 6 Alleged Causing A Collision
